user.title: Connect Energietracker
user.description: Address at which you open Energietracker, for example {example}. For the Energietracker app in Home Assistant, Energietracker shows the address under Connections → Home Assistant (up to 3.11: Settings → Integrations). A read key is only needed when sign-in is switched on in Energietracker (Connections → Keys → API keys for scripts, scope “Read”; up to 3.11: Settings → Access).

data_description.url: Without /api.php; a sub-folder such as /energietracker is fine.
data_description.token: Starts with etk_. It stays in Home Assistant.
data_description.verify_ssl: Switch it off only for https with a certificate of your own.

reauth_confirm.title: Read key for Energietracker
reauth_confirm.description: Energietracker refuses the request (401). Sign-in may have been switched on, or the key was revoked. Enter a key with scope “Read”.

data_description.token: Starts with etk_. It stays in Home Assistant.

error.app_too_old: Energietracker {version} is too old for this integration. Update it to version {minimum} or later.
error.cannot_connect: Energietracker cannot be reached at this address.
error.invalid_auth: Energietracker refuses the read key (or needs one).
error.invalid_response: The answer does not come from Energietracker (version 3.9.0 or later needed).
error.invalid_url: Enter an address with http:// or https://, without query.

abort.already_configured: This Energietracker installation is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The read key has been updated.

app_too_old.message: Energietracker {version} is too old; version {minimum} or later is needed.

app_too_old.title: Energietracker is too old for the integration
app_too_old.description:
The Energietracker at {url} runs version {version}. The integration needs version {minimum} or later: it reads the “To do” list, which came with 3.9.0. Until then the sensors stay unavailable.

Update Energietracker (Docker image, Home Assistant app or files on your web server). The integration retries by itself, and this notice goes away once the update is in place.
